name: agent-guard-dsh
description: Destructive-action reliability layer for AI agents on DeepSeek Harness: intercepts Bash before execution, quarantines deletions to .agent-trash/ with a restorable manifest, snapshots git before overwrites, and escalates compound shapes to the human (Decision Protocol: ALLOW / RELOCATE / SNAPSHOT / ASK / BLOCK). Rules live in one Python core shared across harnesses.

scripts.test: python3 -m unittest discover tests -v && node tests/test_dsh_adapter.mjs
